assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Make a single transparent 1536 by 1536-style square image atlas with an exact invisible 3 by 3 grid, one isolated illustration per cell, read row by row. This is a nine-asset atlas for a first-grade learning game. Each subject must fit fully in its own cell and be centered with completely clear margins of at least 13% of cell width and height. The background outside the items is genuine transparent alpha, including between every item and around the whole sheet. No borders, grids, visible cards, labels, digits, patterns that look like writing, arrows, shadow clouds, lettering, or logos. Match the approved teaching illustration style: fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper silhouette, deep pine green and warm cream with muted apricot accents. Each material sample is large, simple, and unmistakable at reduced size. Do not use fake wood grain on plastic or let stone look like metal.
Row 1 column 1: one safe-edged, thick, honey-oak rectangular material sample, broad flowing visible wood grain on the large face and a little end grain on one short edge. 
Row 1 column 2: one muted honey-brown rounded rectangular molded plastic sample; same warm hue family as the wood swatch, with a subtle rolled molded edge and molded seam, smooth homogeneous color, absolutely no grain.
Row 1 column 3: one olive woven cloth square, one folded-over corner and clearly large, crossed woven threads, soft drape.
Row 2 column 1: one plain folded off-white heavyweight paper piece with a crisp angular bend and paper-thin edge, no cloth fibers or writing.
Row 2 column 2: one rounded-edge clear glass material sample with a narrow pale greenish glass rim and one restrained reflection; its center is clearly transparent and must have genuine partial alpha so the game background can show through. One piece only.
Row 2 column 3: one safe, rounded-corner smooth silver metal plate sample, small bright diffuse highlight, solid opaque body, no holes or writing.
Row 3 column 1: one chunky mottled gray sandstone sample tile, strongly visible matte speckled grain and rounded child-safe silhouette. Distinct from the shiny thinner metal.
Row 3 column 2: one small child-safe exhibit trolley in three-quarter side view, matte apricot body, pine-green handle, exactly two visible dark rubber wheels, paused upright. No payload.
Row 3 column 3: exactly the same exhibit trolley as row 3 column 2, same scale, facing the same direction, same shapes and two visible wheels, tiny rolling lean and slightly shifted wheel spokes for a second animation frame, no motion lines outside the silhouette.
